notes.title: [Announcement Regarding the Postponement of the Release Date]
notes.content:
[Announcement Regarding the Postponement of the Release Date]

We had been working towards releasing Stream Stratos by the end of 2024. However, we have decided to postpone the release date.

We sincerely apologize to everyone who has been eagerly anticipating the game, especially after having the opportunity to showcase the title at various events and gaining exposure among so many people.

Development for Stream Stratos began around the fall of 2023.
Through the development process, we had the opportunity to interact with many people at events, which allowed us to discover numerous new ideas and exciting elements for the game.

As a result, we’ve felt that the game has steadily been moving closer to becoming something truly enjoyable. However, at its current stage, there are still many aspects that we feel are not yet up to our standards.

We kindly ask for a little more time to refine the game to a level of quality that will fully satisfy those who play it.
We greatly appreciate your continued support and encouragement.

Thank you!
